description: Differential vector requested by MoltyCel (x402#2332): the same chain_artifact/leaf_preimage verified twice — once alone, once alongside a revocation_artifact that revokes the mid-chain ancestor hop (hops[1], pioneer-agent-001 -> lightning) before the leaf action's timestamp. delegation-chain-ref-v1's structural invariants (continuity, root/leaf anchoring, scope narrowing, hop_signature, replay) do not reference revocation_ref or revocation-ref.md at all, so both runs verify identically and both PASS. This is the gap MoltyCel's differential test surfaces: an ancestor revoked mid-chain does not change the chain verifier's verdict, because the chain verifier never looks at revocation state.
revocation_note: revoked_action_ref points at hops[1].delegation_ref (the ancestor grant being invalidated), not at a trail action_ref. revocation-ref.md's schema anchors revoked_action_ref to an action's action_ref; delegation-chain-ref.md does not yet define what an ancestor-in-a-chain revocation event should reference. This vector uses the delegation_ref directly as a pragmatic stand-in -- the exact target field is a separate, still-open question from the one this vector demonstrates (that the chain verifier ignores revocation state regardless of what it targets).

vectors.description: 3-hop chain (giskard-self -> pioneer-agent-001 -> lightning -> soma-agent), no revocation considered. Baseline: verifier PASSes on structural invariants alone.

Byte-identical chain_artifact and leaf_preimage to the baseline above. The only difference is the presence of revocation_artifact (top-level, sibling of this file) revoking hops[1].delegation_ref at 2026-08-15T09:00:00.000Z, before the leaf action's timestamp (2026-09-01T12:00:00.000Z). Documented current behavior (not a bug): delegation_chain_ref's derivation and the reference verifier's six invariants (chain_continuity, root_anchoring, leaf_anchoring, monotonic_scope_narrowing, hop_signature_valid, replay_detected) make no reference to revocation_ref, revoked_action_ref, or any external revocation state. Running verify_vector() on this vector reproduces the exact same PASS as the baseline -- delegation_chain_ref is computed purely from chain_artifact, which does not embed or reference the revocation artifact at all. See docs/spec/delegation-chain-ref.md 'What it does not do' for the explicit disclaimer, and the new 'Revocation and already-committed hops (default model)' section for what a verifier without its own policy should assume when it encounters this case.
